source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U22: Apply board composition and independence requirements

payload.title: Board composition is a legal test,not a job-title count
payload.core_explanation_md:
Directors are individuals. The described minimum is three for a public company,two for a private company and one for an OPC. Fifteen is the ordinary maximum,with a special-resolution route to exceed it. Prescribed woman-director requirements and independence requirements must be checked for the relevant company class.

For a listed public company,the described one-third independent-director requirement rounds a fraction upward. Independence involves substantive relationships and qualifications: a nominee or whole-time director is not simply relabelled independent. The primary text uses a financial-year residence test of at least182days,with a proportionate rule for a newly incorporated company; the textbook previous-calendar-year wording is stale.

self_check.prompt_text: Can an employee director be made independent merely by changing the title?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory independence conditions govern.

payload.stem_md: A company wants a sixteenth director and assumes fifteen is an absolute prohibition. Which route does the described framework provide?

options.text_md: Appointment beyond fifteen after the required special resolution
options.explanation_md: The ordinary maximum has an express qualified route.

options.text_md: No company can ever exceed fifteen
Any clerk can approve it informally
options.explanation_md: The prescribed company action is required.

options.text_md: A nominee director is not counted because of the label
options.explanation_md: The label does not create that exclusion.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The ordinary maximum has an express qualified route.

payload.stem_md: A listed public company labels its nominee as independent without testing relationships or statutory qualifications. What is missing?

options.text_md: A rule that all nominees are independent

options.explanation_md: Titles do not replace the legal conditions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Titles do not replace the legal conditions.
